questions: For every failed evaluation family, what joint test is missing and which alternative original material packages can supply it?
From the actual issue-solving chronology, why was the joint check absent or ineffective?
Do independently identified open-model trajectories exhibit comparable gaps?
cohort: All 88 manually supported DeepSeek-v4-flash trajectories, re-evaluated rather than accepted as ground truth.
unit: A concrete evaluation failure family and each distinct identified source set allowed by a manually checked recipe; retain all source sets and a separate inclusion-minimal derivative.
counting: Keep distinct meaningful source units as alternatives; exact duplicate text versions retain all provenance references but do not create fictitious semantic alternatives. Factorized recipes preserve all listed substitutions and declared incompatibilities.
causal_rule: Separate explicit trace statements from supported process inferences. Length or temporal separation alone does not prove forgetting. Check whether A+B was actually already run with a weak oracle or later weakened.
excluded_inputs_to_new_paid_models: No human labels are sent to external model APIs. This run initially uses manual Codex analysis and existing/public artifacts only.
known_cases: Retain original known-case flags; do not count them as independent discoveries.

counting_revision.reason: The user asks for all distinguishable alternative source groups, not just one representative or inclusion-minimal groups. Retain reviewed_source_packages in full; keep source_packages only as an additional qualification-dependent compression view.
counting_revision.qualification: Assemblies require transfer and/or oracle inference as marked; none are newly executed tests.
counting_revision.strict_supported: Exclude disputed and unclear task/verifier contracts from positive bug statistics.
